id: RF-10 (watch report picks its file name by exclusive create)
note: `watch report` with no --out writes <watch>/reports/<date>_watch-report.md, else the next free -2, -3 ... name. It picked the name by a check, then wrote: two runs on the same date could pick one name, and the second read the clash as `REFUSED: output folder not writable` (exit 73). The name is now taken by an exclusive create and a clash moves on to the next number: 12 runs at once each write their own file, and a name taken by a dangling link (which a check reads as free) is skipped, never written through or replaced.

steps.name: a first report takes the plain name
a name taken by a dangling link is skipped
12 reports at once: each writes its own file
